title: natsel team workflow
description: From an idea in the tracker to deleted or merged code

blocks.title: Idea
blocks.details: A product person files it in the tracker.

blocks.title: Code
blocks.details: The skill wraps it as a gene.

blocks.title: Usual checks
blocks.details:
Tests, review, acceptance, stage.

Nothing changes in your quality process. One known gap: **combinations** of genes are not tested on stage. It is covered by binding genes to one locus (dependencies only through nesting) and the fast guardrail path.

blocks.title: Gene pool
blocks.details:
Control Plane builds species, sets weights.

The gene enters the pool and every living species with its **control allele A**. New species are built automatically or by hand; each passes a **smoke test** and an **optional manual approval** before it gets traffic.

Optional manual control comes as **constraints**: max share, ramp-up, segments, forbidden combinations. Not weight edits, so the statistics stay valid.

blocks.title: Selection
blocks.details: Each idea's impact is visible, goes to the ticket.

blocks.title: Delete or fix
blocks.details:
A codemod MR (no AI); the team merges.

- **Extinction / fixation**: the Control Plane opens a merge request from a deterministic codemod (no AI). It keeps the winning allele's branch, removes the flag and deletes the losing branches.
- The team reviews and merges it like any other MR.

New genes come only from people's initiative; the system only combines them.
